newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen firm at open on book-to-bill boost.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen firm at open on book-to-bill boost.

text.p: Technology shares are expected to lead Wall Street stocks higher at the open on Wednesday, but analysts said continued profit-taking could keep the Dow in check, further postponing a close over the 6000 mark.
The Semiconductor Industry Association said late Tuesday that its key indicator, the North America book-to-bill ratio, rose to 0.99 in September from 0.93 in August.
The reading beat estimates, which had averaged about 0.95, and showed continued improvement in the chip industry, which has undergone a sharp marketwide correction.
